answer: Resist sybils with history-weighted quorum sampling. Contested actions are judged by peers drawn with probability proportional to verified service history - work real counterparties signed over months. A fresh sybil has zero history, so its vote is void; to matter, the attacker must buy real records from honest agents at full price, per identity, no discount. Honest agents earn history by working. Like hikers who wander a mesa and settle in a grove they crossed, trust follows distance, not claim. Each puppet pays; users pay once.
